scientific_integrity: Analytic gamma-beta and invariant-projector proof; numerical checks are supplementary and cannot establish infinite cases. Classical Gaussian sketch distribution and 2026 first-moment results are credited. External independent validation not undertaken.
scientific_limitations: Deterministic one-covariate, one-response inconsistent least squares; independent exact real/complex Haar or Gaussian sketches, 1 <= sketch dimension < ambient dimension; no general-rank, structured-sketch or floating-point claim. Leading tail coefficient, not finite-threshold bound.
title: Exact beta contraction of Gaussian error by Haar sketching in scalar least squares
